title: Epoch Economic Simulation Suite Summary (S-1 to S-5)

H1.statement: Epoch lowers maker adverse-selection loss relative to CLOB with multiple snipers (k=5)
H1.metric: 91.0% reduction in maker adverse selection loss [SIMULATED]

H2.statement: With one dominant sniper (k=1), the reduction in adverse selection shrinks toward zero

H3.statement: H3: Some maker offset gives non-negative expected PnL for a given lambda; required offset grows with lambda

H4.statement: H4: Cranker oracle-selection option is worth less than the fee per trade in a tight window (W=4)
H4.metric: W=4 option 1.611 bps vs 1.5 bps maker fee (exceeds maker fee, below 3.0 bps taker fee) [SIMULATED]

H5.statement: H5: With target-ahead (L=3, N=2), at least 90% of orders land in their target batch
H5.metric: N=2, L=3 gives 70.03%; N=4, L=3 gives 97.67% [SIMULATED]

H6.statement: Uninformed traders pay less (or not more) in Epoch than in CLOB
H6.metric: Uninformed cost 5.993 bps in Epoch vs 6.013 bps in CLOB [SIMULATED]

mev_and_threats.R1_toxic_flow_mitigation: Break-even maker quote offset requires >= 6 bps for 800ms oracle lag
mev_and_threats.R2_cranker_option: Mean option value is 1.611 bps in 4-slot window; requires permissionless keeper competition
mev_and_threats.R4_last_look_mev: 100.0% priority-based frontrunning elimination in batch auction
mev_and_threats.R6_vault_solvency: Vault quotes with 15/25/35 bps offsets remain safely positive expected PnL
